inheritedNotes:
Life 1 (Prime Minister):
PM is reachable as local grad, no scholarship. Hidden ceilings exist (file: Deputy Secretary, party: SMS) and rise via people choices. Biggest raiser: teach and back juniors (Y15 officer returns at Y48 'Officer You Taught', choose 'Tell him he was worth the trouble'). Honest disclosure gives INTEG and a GRC fielding. Walk every block at GE for REP and vote share. Network, volunteer for hard work, ask RO what she needs. Plain-speaking costs STAND but didn't stop PM. Y40-45 DPM years are mostly single-option; don't expect agency. Untested: GDP/employment indicators, offsite A/B, asking ceiling, laughing along, B and C at MPS. Try to speed up the early climb and test whether succession choice at Y39 was needed.

Life 2 (Lost the Ward):
PM is reachable; the ceiling rose to PM at Y50 by trusting the officer I nominated ('Let her decide without hearing from you'). Hidden ceilings (file: Deputy Secretary, party: SMS) rise via people choices: back juniors, nominate, then step back. Disclose everything. Y14 asking ceiling directly: STAND-4, INTEG+4, promoted. Do NOT ask Cabinet about indicators (STAND-14). Plain PQ answers cost STAND. GE: campaign on record gave 61.2% vs walking 58.6%; the last walk-every-block run lost at 48.2%, so prefer record. At succession (Y38) test backing the other name. Test Board Seat, B/C at MPS, A/B at bonus. Network, ask RO what she needs, laugh along, walk a GRC at REP 60.

Life 3 (Retired, Honourably):
PM needs the hidden ceilings raised: file Deputy Secretary, party SMS. They rise through people choices: teach and back juniors early, nominate, then step back ('Let her decide without hearing from you'; Y48 'Officer You Taught': 'Tell him he was worth the trouble'). Ask for the hard ministry at the Reshuffle EARLY; it raised the ceiling to DPM but that is not PM. Reporting officer saying 'steady' means promotion is blocked by the ceiling; act on it. Disclose everything. Ask ceiling directly at Y14 (STAND-4, INTEG+4, promoted). Never ask Cabinet about indicators (STAND-14). Pushing GDP gives bonus and STAND but costs INTEG. GE: campaign on record. At succession do NOT put yourself forward; nominate and step back, and test backing the other name. Untested: Board Seat A, laughing along.
